Marissa / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround. Wed 9/22 09:00 PT works for our team — locking it in. Calendar invite sent.

A few priorities I'm flagging so we can cover them in the 45-minute intake:
- Data residency / multi-region failover: which regions see production customer data and what controls exist for geo-failover.
- Key management: whether Redwood uses customer-managed keys (CMKs), the HSM provider, and rotation cadence.
- Logging retention & access: default retention period and how to request longer retention windows.
- Incident detection telemetry: which signals are collected and average alerting mean time to detect.

Attached the CAIQ export (same as before) and a short internal checklist of items we need on hand. If you can drop the KMS diagram and an example log stub in the shared Drive prior to the call, that would be ideal.

Procurement (copied) will follow up on contract/SLAs after the technical intake.
